questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Frankfurt er et af verdens økonomiske milepæle, med ECB begliggende i byen og over 200 banker inregisteret i byen gør det som en unikom som økonomi som studerende at opleve!

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Utrolig kompliceret og svært at finde rundt i et nyt skole system, at lære et helt nyt skolesystem at kende på 1 måned, er meget besværligt

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Skolen var god til at tage imod os, men det var bare kompliceret at omstille sig til et nyt system, men skolen gjorde sit bedste.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Goethe universitet (Host uni) var enormt behjælplig, de fandt et sted man kunne bo, de havde intro dage, mange mails med information. Super oplevelse, men det var hårdt

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Det var enomrt nemt, da uni blot gav et link man kunne søge igennem også fik jeg en lejlighed en måned før jeg ankom.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Det er en god mulighed for at komme lidt ud af uni boblen og opleve byen på en anden måde, jeg boede via noget fra uni, så det var også billigt.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Enormt nemt, uni lader det hele gå godt! De har infor timer og alt muligt dertil så du bliver slæpt igennem dette.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Du ankommer, også følger du bare de mails som skolen har sendt til dig hele perioden optil du skal starte

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Fysisk, mail, telefoninsk

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Det var mere kompliceret fordi der ikke er uendeligt plads på alle hold og du kæmper med mange andre elever om at komme ind på faget, så fik 3/5 hold jeg gerne vil have.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Følg de intro mails som host uni sender, så skal det nok gå!

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Jeg har ikke fået karakter fra 2 ud af 5 fag, men dem jeg har fået har outcome været meget godt i forhold til det input jeg har smidt (Det har været let at få sehr gut!) Men de skriftlige fag har været sværere end jeg har prøvet andre steder.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Det er meget det samme! Forlæsninger og holdnundervisninger! Det minder meget om det samme som UCPH

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Firm Training
Topics in Financial and Non-Financial Reporting
Banking and Regulation
Monetary Theory and Policy
Topics in Banking and Macro

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Firm Training, giver et virkelig godt billede af hvordan og hvorfor virksomheder vælger at træne deres ansatte. Enomrt indblik i hvorfor og hvordan virksomheder reagere!

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Ingen ting

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: At leve dernede er billigt, tyskland har ikke en dyr leve omkostning

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Skolen har mange tilbud, alt fra faldskærm udspring til skak-klub så alt i mellem himmel og jord

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Jeg startede til skak, vi spillede hver tirsdag, hvor jeg blev undervist af en grand-master en enorm oplevelse for 250 kr i alt for 5 måneder

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Oplev tyskland, det er et enormt land som byder på alt fra bjerge sydpå til fladland i norden, historien fra de små byer til store byer giver også super god mening også kan du fra Frankfurt komme rundt i hele europa med tog for ingen penge! Udnyt det!

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Meget nemt, danskere og tyskere er meget ens.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Svært, men sådan er det bare, kender det selv fra danmark.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Ingen

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Jeg kan virkelig godt lide ordenligheden. Det er en kæmpe oplevelse at mærke den ordenlighed som tyskerne har!

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. Nyd det (Der kan være mange indtryk og en følelse af man skal nå så meget som muligt, men tag nogle dage hvor du bare slapper af og hygger dig! Det handler ikke om at nå mest, men at have energi til at nyde det mest)
2. Kom til forlæsningerne, det er en stor oplevelse at opleve uni-livet, det får du ikke lov til derhjemme
3. Tyskland er et land som de færreste kender, lær landet at kende, lær mennekserne at kende, lær deres historie at kende.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Nej ikke rigtigt

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: At opleve at bo og studere i et andet land, det har gjort mig mere hel som menneske, en oplevelse jeg aldrig vil glemme

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: At stå i et andet land lige pludselig også finde ud af hvordan man kan klare det og man kan sagtens klare det i danmark, men man kan også klare det i andre lande

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
